archetypes.name: dyn-invariants-parser
archetypes.rationale: The change seeds machine-read invariant headings with parser-sensitive IDs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review ARCHITECTURAL_INVARIANTS.md for heading shape and parser compatibility. Confirm the I-* IDs remain visible to both the learn-from-bugs coverage index and architectural-invariants reader. Check that any lint-compatible grouping does not become an indexed invariant itself and that the supplied body paragraphs remain intact. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
